fields.climate: mostly semiarid; subtropical along east coast; sunny days, cool nights
fields.terrain: vast interior plateau rimmed by rugged hills and narrow coastal plain
fields.hazards: prolonged droughts; volcanism: the volcano that formed Marion Island in the Prince Edward Islands is South Africa's only active volcano
fields.resources: gold, chromium, antimony, coal, iron ore, manganese, nickel, phosphates, tin, rare earth elements, uranium, gem diamonds, platinum, copper, vanadium, salt, natural gas
fields.farm: sugarcane, maize, milk, soybeans, potatoes, wheat, grapes, chicken, oranges, apples
fields.exports: gold, platinum, coal, cars, iron ore
fields.industries: mining (world's largest producer of platinum, gold, chromium), automobile assembly, metalworking, machinery, textiles, iron and steel, chemicals, fertilizer, foodstuffs, commercial ship repair
fields.languages: isiZulu or Zulu (official) 25.3%, isiXhosa or Xhosa (official) 14.8%, Afrikaans (official) 12.2%, Sepedi or Pedi (official) 10.1%, Setswana or Tswana (official) 9.1%, English (official) 8.1%, Sesotho…
fields.religions: Christian 86%, ancestral, tribal, animist, or other traditional African religions 5.4%, Muslim 1.9%, other 1.5%, nothing in particular 5.2%

independence.from: four British colonies: Cape Colony, Natal, Transvaal, and Orange Free State

fields.legal: mixed system of Roman-Dutch civil law, English common law, and customary law
fields.military: 18-22 (18-26 for college graduates) years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; initial 24-month service obligation
fields.colours: red, green, blue, yellow, black, white
